recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見瀰漫性紅疹（DRESS）；淋巴結副皮質區明顯擴張，高倍可見大型單核細胞帶有核內與細胞質包涵體，HHV-6 染色呈顆粒狀陽性，ICOS 標記副皮質 T 細胞、CD20 陽性 B 細胞被推擠到外皮質，屬於模仿淋巴瘤的病毒性淋巴結炎。
features: Lymph node with marked paracortical expansion and compression of residual follicles toward the capsule at low power (B)
Polymorphous paracortex with many large mononuclear cells bearing eosinophilic nuclear and cytoplasmic inclusions among small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells (C)
HHV-6 immunostain decorates scattered large cells with membranous and dot-like Golgi/cytoplasmic positivity (D)
ICOS positivity in the expanded paracortical T-cell population including infected cells (E)
CD20-positive B cells restricted to a thin rim of the far cortex (F)
Clinical photo of a confluent erythematous morbilliform rash on the extremity (A)
describe_en: The lymph node shows distorted architecture with marked paracortical expansion, while B cells highlighted by CD20 are largely confined to the far cortex. The expanded paracortex contains a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, immunoblasts and scattered large mononuclear cells with conspicuous nuclear and cytoplasmic inclusions. The large cells are immunoreactive for HHV-6 with membrane and Golgi-type positivity, and the paracortical T cells express ICOS. In the setting of a diffuse drug rash with eosinophilia, findings are consistent with HHV-6 lymphadenitis associated with DRESS syndrome; clonality studies (negative TCR gamma PCR) help exclude a T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: AITL also expresses TFH markers such as ICOS but shows clear-cell TFH clusters, arborizing HEVs, expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks and clonal TCR rearrangement, without HHV-6+ inclusion-bearing cells.
PTCL shows cytologically atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR, rather than viral inclusions with a reactive, polyclonal background.
Paracortical expansion is due to pale Langerhans/interdigitating cells with melanin-laden macrophages, not large cells with viral inclusions.
Paracortical immunoblasts are EBER-positive and lack HHV-6 immunoreactivity and nuclear inclusions.

stain: Clinical photo; H&E; IHC: HHV-6, ICOS, CD20
